name: bloggity
description: Manage your Bloggity blog from your coding agent: review the Tasks queue, schedule posts, accept keyword suggestions, and run Research Tasks over the Bloggity MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage your Bloggity blog's Tasks queue, keywords and research.
interface.longDescription: Review your Bloggity Tasks queue, schedule post topics, accept or defer keyword suggestions, and manage Research Tasks from your coding agent. Sign in with your Bloggity account in the browser; access is limited to your own team's data.
defaultPrompt: Schedule my next Bloggity topic on the next open day
List the research suggestions for my blog
